yt_title: Why Your Voice Sounds Different on Recordings #Shorts
desc: You hear your own voice through air and through the bones of your skull. Recordings capture only the air part. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Everyone hates hearing their own voice. 🎙️ Do you? Comment below.

lines.text: Why does your voice sound strange on a recording?
When you talk, you hear your voice two ways.
Bone carries low sounds well, so your own voice sounds deeper to you.
A recording only captures the air part, the way everyone else hears you.
So the recording is the real one. Your head is the odd one out.

v.s: You just aren't used to it
